detail.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview


ROCm follow-up to [#61978](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61978), which adds day-0 support for Reflection's [Beam 1.0](https://huggingface.co/reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B) and its [DFlash2 drafter](https://huggingface.co/reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2).


EDIT: Since #61978 has been split into smaller PRs (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62042, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62052, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62074), I've updated against main and now the PR diff isn't swamped by the changes from #61978.

This PR adds AMD-owned implementations under `vllm/models/beam/amd/` for both `BeamForCausalLM` and `DFlash2BeamDraftModel`. The NVIDIA implementation from #61978 is unchanged in the relative diff. Shared package dispatch selects the AMD classes on ROCm and the NVIDIA classes elsewhere.

## Claims

- Beam 1.0 BF16 loads and serves on 8x MI350X with TP8 and expert parallelism through the AMD model path.
- Beam's required FP32 activation, normalization, Q/K preprocessing, attention-output gate, and logit-softcap arithmetic is retained in AMD-local Triton kernels.
- The AMD target uses standard vLLM ROCm attention and KV-cache updates, linear layers, finalized MoE output, and RCCL collectives rather than NVIDIA direct-cache, CuTe/FlashInfer, or MNNVL fast paths.
- The AMD DFlash2 implementation loads the released 1.93B drafter, generates successfully, and delegates cache writes and cache-format handling to the selected ROCm attention backend.
- The change adds no HIP/C++ kernels and does not modify the scheduler, KV-cache manager, model runner, attention backends, or NVIDIA Beam implementation.
- Added recipe in line with https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/issues/1107

### Serving commands

Target only:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 131072 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --reasoning-parser beam \
  --tool-call-parser beam \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice
```

With DFlash2:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --speculative-config '{
    "method": "dflash",
    "model": "reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2",
    "num_speculative_tokens": 8
  }'
```

## Validation

**Setup:** 8x AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), ROCm 10.1, PyTorch 2.13, TP8 with expert parallelism, Beam 1.0 BF16 and the BF16 DFlash2 drafter.

| Check | Target only | DFlash2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ruff checks and formatting | Passed | Passed |
| Current-source ROCm build | Passed | Passed |
| Full 501B checkpoint and drafter load | Passed | Passed |
| GSM8K, 1,319 questions, strict extraction | 1,202/1,319 (91.13% ± 0.78%) | 1,200/1,319 (90.98% ± 0.79%) |
| GSM8K, 1,319 questions, flexible extraction | 1,212/1,319 (91.89% ± 0.75%) | 1,212/1,319 (91.89% ± 0.75%) |

The GSM8K used 5-shot chat, greedy decoding, `max_gen_toks=1024`, TP8, and expert parallelism.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction commands</summary>

```bash
lm_eval \
  --model vllm \
  --model_args pretrained=/path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B,tensor_parallel_size=8,dtype=bfloat16,max_model_len=16384,gpu_memory_utilization=0.85,enable_expert_parallel=True \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 5 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --apply_chat_template \
  --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=1024
```

The lm-eval vLLM wrapper also accepts the top-level speculative aliases:

```text
spec_method=dflash,spec_model=/path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2,spec_tokens=8
```

```bash
vllm bench serve \
  --backend vllm \
  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --model beam \
  --tokenizer /path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dataset-name random \
  --num-prompts 10 \
  --random-input-len 8192 \
  --random-output-len 10 \
  --max-concurrency 10 \
  --request-rate inf \
  --ignore-eos \
  --temperature 0 \
  --seed 42
```

</details>

### Short concurrency sweep
On NVIDIA SPEED-Bench `throughput_8k` / `low_entropy`, with a fixed 1,024-token output, greedy decoding, 16 warmup requests per point, and `10 * concurrency` measured requests:

| Concurrency | Prompts | Target tok/s | DFlash2 tok/s | Speedup | Target TTFT | DFlash2 TTFT | Acceptance length |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 10 | 117.40 | 168.47 | 1.44x | 234.66 ms | 241.48 ms | 3.41 |
| 4 | 40 | 331.88 | 443.00 | 1.33x | 657.87 ms | 297.50 ms | 3.51 |
| 8 | 80 | 492.26 | 769.78 | 1.56x | 634.83 ms | 240.43 ms | 3.63 |
| 16 | 160 | 803.81 | 1,263.22 | 1.57x | 788.46 ms | 265.18 ms | 3.57 |

All 580 measured requests across both modes succeeded. DFlash2 token acceptance ranged from 30.13% to 32.83%. These are single runs without variability estimates.

<details>
<summary>SPEED-Bench run configuration</summary>

Both servers used the same target configuration:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve /path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --max-model-len 16384 \
  --max-num-seqs 16 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 131072 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --served-model-name beam \
  --disable-log-requests
```

The DFlash2 server added:

```bash
--speculative-config '{
  "method": "dflash",
  "model": "/path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-DFlash2",
  "num_speculative_tokens": 8
}'
```

Each server was reused across all four concurrency points. `vllm bench serve` issued its initial probe and 16 warmup requests before the measured requests at each point:

```bash
for concurrency in 1 4 8 16; do
  num_prompts=$((10 * concurrency))
  vllm bench serve \
    --backend vllm \
    --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
    --model beam \
    --tokenizer /path/to/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
    --dataset-name speed_bench \
    --dataset-path /path/to/prepared/speed-bench \
    --speed-bench-dataset-subset throughput_8k \
    --speed-bench-category low_entropy \
    --speed-bench-output-len 1024 \
    --num-prompts "${num_prompts}" \
    --num-warmups 16 \
    --max-concurrency "${concurrency}" \
    --request-rate inf \
    --ignore-eos \
    --temperature 0 \
    --seed 42
done
```

</details>

### Remaining validation

- [x] Accuracy benchmarks (with and without dflash2)
  - [X] GSM8k 
  - [x] GPQA-diamond
  - [x] AIME2025
- [X] Performance baseline using NVIDIA [speedbench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/SPEED-Bench) 8k with low entropy and 1k fixed OSL
- [x] Same checks for gfx942

## Details

- **Vendor ownership:** All ROCm target and DFlash2 implementation code lives under `vllm/models/beam/amd/`. The relative diff does not modify `vllm/models/beam/nvidia/`.
- **Platform dispatch:** `vllm.models.beam` exports AMD target and draft classes on ROCm and NVIDIA classes on other platforms.
- **Target execution:** AMD attention uses ordinary backend-owned K/V cache updates. AMD projections use standard vLLM linear layers, MoE returns finalized output normally, and distributed reductions use standard RCCL paths.
- **DFlash2 cache handling:** AMD-local Triton computes context K normalization and RoPE. Cache layout, slot scattering, optional shuffling, and quantization are delegated to each ROCm attention backend's native cache-update API rather than hard-coded pointer arithmetic.
- **Numerics:** AMD-local Triton kernels retain Beam's required FP32 operations and intermediate BF16 rounding boundaries.
- **HIP launch compatibility:** AMD kernels omit CUDA-only Triton launch options such as `enable_reflect_ftz` and `launch_pdl`.
- **Footprint:** 1,968 additions and 2 deletions across 12 Beam model files; no core execution or NVIDIA implementation changes.

AI assistance was used. The submitter should review every changed line and this description before converting the PR from draft.

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.triton_utils import tldevice as libdevice
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["size"])
+def _silu_mul_kernel(X, Y, size, width: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    src = i // width * (2 * width) + i % width
+    gate = tl.load(X + src, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    up = tl.load(X + src + width, i < size, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    act = tl.div_rn(gate, 1.0 + libdevice.exp(-gate))
+    tl.store(Y + i, act * up, i < size)
+
+
+def beam_silu_mul(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute SiLU and multiplication in FP32, rounding only the product."""
+    width = x.shape[-1] // 2
+    output = torch.empty((*x.shape[:-1], width), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    if output.numel():
+        _silu_mul_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 1024),)](
+            x, output, output.numel(), width, 1024, enable_fp_fusion=False
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _softcap_logits_kernel(
+    X,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CAP: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    x = tl.load(X + row * STRIDE + col, col < WIDTH, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    y = libdevice.tanh(x * (1.0 / CAP)) * CAP
+    tl.store(X + row * STRIDE + col, y, col < WIDTH)
+
+
+def beam_softcap_logits(logits: torch.Tensor, cap: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Softcap in FP32 and round back into the original logits buffer."""
+    assert logits.ndim == 2 and logits.stride(1) == 1
+    if logits.numel():
+        _softcap_logits_kernel[(logits.shape[0], triton.cdiv(logits.shape[1], 1024))](
+            logits,
+            logits.shape[1],
+            logits.stride(0),
+            cap,
+            1024,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return logits

+"""Fused Q/K normalization, position transforms, and attention output gating."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.triton_utils import tldevice as libdevice
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["SIZE"])
+def _output_gate_kernel(
+    X,
+    G,
+    B,
+    Y,
+    SIZE,
+    G_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    FLOOR: tl.constexpr,
+    TEMPERATURE: tl.constexpr,
+    BIAS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    i = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    dtype = G.dtype.element_ty
+    g_idx = i // (HEADS * DIM) * G_STRIDE + i % (HEADS * DIM)
+    g = tl.load(G + g_idx, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    if BIAS:
+        b = tl.load(B + i // DIM % HEADS).to(tl.float32)
+        g = (g + b).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    g = (g / TEMPERATURE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    sigmoid = (1.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-g))).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    multiplier = (sigmoid * (1.0 - FLOOR)).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    multiplier = (multiplier + FLOOR).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    x = tl.load(X + i, i < SIZE, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(Y + i, x * multiplier, i < SIZE)
+
+
+def beam_output_gate(
+    attn_output: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_bias: torch.Tensor | None,
+    *,
+    num_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    floor: float = 0.0,
+    temperature: float = 1.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fuse gate operations while retaining activation-dtype rounding."""
+    output = torch.empty_like(attn_output)
+    if output.numel():
+        _output_gate_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 256),)](
+            attn_output,
+            gate,
+            gate_bias,
+            output,
+            output.numel(),
+            gate.stride(0),
+            num_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            floor,
+            temperature,
+            gate_bias is not None,
+            256,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=["M", "NUM_SLOTS"], do_not_specialize_on_alignment=["POS"]
+)
+def _qk_norm_rope_kernel(
+    Q,
+    K,
+    QW,
+    KW,
+    POS,
+    CACHE,
+    OQ,
+    OK,
+    M,
+    V,
+    KV_CACHE,
+    SLOTS,
+    NUM_SLOTS,
+    WRITE_CACHE: tl.constexpr,
+    V_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_BLOCK_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_HEAD_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    CACHE_TOKEN_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    TOKENS: tl.constexpr,
+    Q_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    K_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    Q_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    K_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    ROTARY: tl.constexpr,
+    NEOX: tl.constexpr,
+    SSMAX: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * TOKENS + tl.arange(0, TOKENS)
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+    c = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < DIM)
+    if head < Q_HEADS:
+        x = tl.load(
+            Q + token[:, None] * Q_STRIDE + head * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        y = y * tl.load(QW + c, c < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)[None, :]
+        out = OQ + (token[:, None] * Q_HEADS + head) * DIM
+    else:
+        h = head - Q_HEADS
+        x = tl.load(K + token[:, None] * K_STRIDE + h * DIM + c[None, :], mask, 0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+        if BLOCK == 128:
+            squares = (x * x).reshape((TOKENS, 4, 32))
+            total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+        else:
+            total = tl.sum(x * x, 1)
+        y = x * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None]
+        y = y * tl.load(KW + c, c < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)[None, :]
+        out = OK + (token[:, None] * K_HEADS + h) * DIM
+    y = y.to(Q.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    if ROTARY:
+        half: tl.constexpr = ROTARY // 2
+        if NEOX:
+            partner = tl.where(c < half, c + half, c - half)
+            second = c >= half
+            offset = c % half
+        else:
+            partner = c ^ 1
+            second = c % 2 != 0
+            offset = c // 2
+        partner = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(partner, 0), BLOCK - 1)
+        other = tl.gather(y, tl.broadcast_to(partner[None, :], (TOKENS, BLOCK)), axis=1)
+        pos = tl.load(POS + token, token < M, 0).to(tl.int64)
+        rope_mask = (token[:, None] < M) & (c[None, :] < ROTARY)
+        cos = tl.load(CACHE + pos[:, None] * ROTARY + offset[None, :], rope_mask, 0)
+        sin = tl.load(
+            CACHE + pos[:, None] * ROTARY + half + offset[None, :], rope_mask, 0
+        )
+        rotated = tl.where(
+            second[None, :],
+            tl.fma(other, sin, y * cos),
+            tl.fma(y, cos, -other * sin),
+        )
+        y = tl.where(c[None, :] < ROTARY, rotated, y)
+    elif SSMAX:
+        if head < Q_HEADS:
+            # (1 + (position + 1) / 2048) ** 0.1
+            p = tl.load(POS + token, token < M, 0).to(tl.float32) + 1
+            scale = libdevice.exp(0.1 * libdevice.log1p(p / 2048.0))
+            y = y * scale[:, None]
+    tl.store(out + c[None, :], y, mask)
+    if WRITE_CACHE and head >= Q_HEADS:
+        slot = tl.load(SLOTS + token, token < NUM_SLOTS, -1).to(tl.int64)
+        cache_mask = mask & (token[:, None] < NUM_SLOTS) & (slot[:, None] >= 0)
+        address = (
+            slot[:, None] // PAGE_SIZE * CACHE_BLOCK_STRIDE
+            + slot[:, None] % PAGE_SIZE * CACHE_TOKEN_STRIDE
+            + (head - Q_HEADS) * CACHE_HEAD_STRIDE
+            + c[None, :]
+        )
+        tl.store(KV_CACHE + address, y, cache_mask)
+        value = tl.load(
+            V + token[:, None] * V_STRIDE + (head - Q_HEADS) * DIM + c[None, :],
+            cache_mask,
+            0,
+        )
+        tl.store(KV_CACHE + address + DIM, value, cache_mask)
+
+
+def beam_qk_norm_rope(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    q_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int = 0,
+    is_neox_style: bool = True,
+    *,
+    ssmax: bool = False,
+    value: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Round norm before position transforms and optionally insert BF16 K/V."""
+    if kv_cache is not None:
+        assert value is not None and slot_mapping is not None
+        assert kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        assert kv_cache.ndim == 4 and kv_cache.stride(-1) == 1
+    q_out, k_out = torch.empty_like(q), torch.empty_like(k)
+    q_heads, k_heads = q.shape[-1] // head_dim, k.shape[-1] // head_dim
+    if q.shape[0]:
+        if rotary_dim or q.shape[0] < 512:
+            tile, warps = 4, 4
+        elif q.shape[0] <= 2048:
+            tile, warps = 16, 8
+        else:
+            tile, warps = 32, 4
+        _qk_norm_rope_kernel[(triton.cdiv(q.shape[0], tile), q_heads + k_heads)](
+            q,
+            k,
+            q_weight,
+            k_weight,
+            positions,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            q_out,
+            k_out,
+            q.shape[0],
+            value,
+            kv_cache,
+            slot_mapping,
+            slot_mapping.numel() if slot_mapping is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache is not None,
+            value.stride(0) if value is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(0) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(1) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.stride(2) if kv_cache is not None else 0,
+            kv_cache.shape[2] if kv_cache is not None else 1,
+            tile,
+            q_heads,
+            k_heads,
+            head_dim,
+            q.stride(0),
+            k.stride(0),
+            eps,
+            rotary_dim,
+            is_neox_style,
+            ssmax,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(head_dim),
+            num_warps=warps,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return q_out, k_out

+"""DFlash2 draft model for Beam targets.
+
+A DFlash2 drafter predicts a block of tokens at once from hidden states the
+Beam target captures at `dflash_config.target_layer_ids`, then a low-rank
+candidate selector rescores the top-k tokens at each block position against
+the token before it. The drafter shares the target's embeddings and LM head.
+
+Nothing here is torch-compiled. The DFlash speculator captures the whole draft
+step (decoder layers, candidate head and selector) in its own CUDA graphs, and
+the context K/V precompute runs eagerly as a few fused kernels.
+"""

+class DFlash2BeamAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Query-token attention; the context K/V is already in the KV cache."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config,
+        layer_idx: int,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        total_num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
+        total_num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
+        assert total_num_heads % tp_size == 0
+        if total_num_kv_heads >= tp_size:
+            assert total_num_kv_heads % tp_size == 0
+        else:
+            assert tp_size % total_num_kv_heads == 0
+        self.num_heads = total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        # Every layer is non-causal sliding-window attention over the block.
+        assert config.layer_types[layer_idx] == "sliding_attention"
+        assert not config.is_causal
+        self.causal = False
+
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            total_num_heads,
+            total_num_kv_heads,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+        self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+            self.head_dim,
+            max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+            is_neox_style=True,
+            rope_parameters=config.rope_parameters,
+        )
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.head_dim**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            per_layer_sliding_window=config.sliding_window,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+        )
+        backend = self.attn.attn_backend
+        self.fuse_kv_insert = (
+            not backend.forward_includes_kv_cache_update
+            and backend.supports_kv_cache_update_bypass
+            and self.attn.impl.dcp_world_size == 1
+            and self.attn.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is None
+            and self.attn.kv_cache_dtype in ("auto", "bfloat16")
+        )
+        self.attn.kv_cache_update_bypass = self.fuse_kv_insert
+        self.q_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.k_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.v_scale = config.dflash_config.get("attention_value_scale")
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        from .attention_ops import beam_qk_norm_rope
+
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        if self.v_scale is not None:
+            v = v * self.v_scale
+        cache, slots = None, None
+        mapping = get_forward_context().slot_mapping
+        assert isinstance(mapping, dict)
+        if (
+            self.fuse_kv_insert
+            and mapping
+            and self.attn.kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            slots = mapping[self.attn.layer_name]
+            cache = self.attn.kv_cache
+            assert cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            assert cache.ndim == 4
+        rope = self.rotary_emb
+        q, k = beam_qk_norm_rope(
+            q,
+            k,
+            self.q_norm.weight,
+            self.k_norm.weight,
+            self.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            positions,
+            rope.cos_sin_cache,
+            self.head_dim,
+            rope.rotary_dim,
+            rope.is_neox_style,
+            value=v,
+            kv_cache=cache,
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+        )
+        output = self.attn(q, k, v) if cache is None else self.attn(q, None, None)

+class DFlash2BeamMLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, intermediate_size: int, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate_up_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            [intermediate_size] * 2,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate_up_proj",
+        )
+        self.down_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            intermediate_size,
+            hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
+        )
+        self.act_fn = SiluAndMul()
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        x, _ = self.down_proj(self.act_fn(x))
+        return x

+        )

+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,

+            block_size=1 + vllm_config.speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens,

+        )

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["ROWS"])
+def _transform_context_kv_kernel(
+    KV,
+    WEIGHT,
+    POSITIONS,
+    ROPE,
+    KEY_OUT,
+    VALUE_OUT,
+    ROWS,
+    LAYERS: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    VALUE_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    NEOX: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * 4 + tl.arange(0, 4)
+    layer_head = tl.program_id(1)
+    layer = layer_head // HEADS
+    head = layer_head % HEADS
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = (row[:, None] < ROWS) & (col[None, :] < DIM)
+    kv_offsets = (
+        row[:, None] * (LAYERS * 2 * HEADS * DIM)
+        + (layer * 2 * HEADS + head) * DIM
+        + col[None, :]
+    )
+    key = tl.load(KV + kv_offsets, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    if BLOCK == 128:
+        squares = (key * key).reshape((4, 4, 32))
+        total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+    else:
+        total = tl.sum(key * key, 1)
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + layer * DIM + col, col < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    key = key * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None] * weight[None, :]
+    # Beam rounds K normalization before RoPE.
+    key = key.to(KV.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    half: tl.constexpr = DIM // 2
+    if NEOX:
+        partner = (col + half) % DIM
+        second = col >= half
+        rope_col = col % half
+    else:
+        partner = col ^ 1
+        second = col % 2 != 0
+        rope_col = col // 2
+    other = tl.gather(key, tl.broadcast_to(partner[None, :], (4, BLOCK)), 1)
+    position = tl.load(POSITIONS + row, row < ROWS, 0).to(tl.int64)
+    cosine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    sine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + half + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    key = tl.where(
+        second[None, :],
+        tl.fma(other, sine, key * cosine),
+        tl.fma(key, cosine, -other * sine),
+    )
+    out_offsets = (
+        (layer * ROWS + row[:, None]) * (HEADS * DIM) + head * DIM + col[None, :]
+    )
+    value = tl.load(KV + kv_offsets + HEADS * DIM, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(KEY_OUT + out_offsets, key, mask)
+    tl.store(VALUE_OUT + out_offsets, value * VALUE_SCALE, mask)
+
+
+def transform_context_kv(
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    rope: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    value_scale: float,
+    is_neox: bool,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Apply Beam K normalization/RoPE and V scaling without touching caches."""
+    rows, layers, _, heads, dim = kv.shape
+    keys = torch.empty((layers, rows, heads, dim), dtype=kv.dtype, device=kv.device)
+    values = torch.empty_like(keys)
+    if rows:
+        _transform_context_kv_kernel[(triton.cdiv(rows, 4), layers * heads)](
+            kv,
+            weight,
+            positions,
+            rope,
+            keys,
+            values,
+            rows,
+            layers,
+            heads,
+            dim,
+            eps,
+            value_scale,
+            is_neox,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(dim),
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return keys, values

+@triton.jit
+def _conv_residual_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    DELTA,
+    BASE,
+    RESIDUAL,
+    WEIGHT,
+    OUTPUT,
+    X_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_ROW_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_TAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    RESIDUAL_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    TAPS: tl.constexpr,
+    QUERY: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = col < WIDTH
+    group = col // GROUP
+    coefficient = tl.load(BASE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32) + tl.load(
+        DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + group, mask, 0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    value = tl.load(X + row * X_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = coefficient * value
+    for tap in tl.static_range(1, TAPS):
+        valid = mask & (row % QUERY >= tap)
+        coefficient = tl.load(BASE + tap * WIDTH + col, valid, 0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        ) + tl.load(
+            DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + tap * DELTA_TAP_STRIDE + group,
+            valid,
+            0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        value = tl.load(X + (row - tap) * X_STRIDE + col, valid, 0).to(tl.float32)
+        result = tl.fma(coefficient, value, result)
+    result = result.to(X.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    residual = tl.load(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = (result + residual).to(RESIDUAL.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, result, mask)
+    variance = tl.sum(result * result, 0) / WIDTH
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(
+        OUTPUT + row * WIDTH + col,
+        result * tl.rsqrt(variance + EPS) * weight,
+        mask,
+    )

+
+def conv_residual_norm(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    coefficients: torch.Tensor,
+    base: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    query_len: int,
+    group_size: int,
+    *,
+    num_warps: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Finish grouped convolution and update the residual before RMSNorm."""
+    rows, width = hidden.shape
+    block = triton.next_power_of_2(width)
+    if num_warps is None:
+        num_warps = 16 if rows <= 256 else (8 if rows < 4096 else 4)
+    # Extra 64-lane wavefronts replicate the block, and a replica can reload
+    # RESIDUAL after another wavefront has updated it in place.
+    # https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/issues/12616
+    num_warps = min(num_warps, max(1, block // 64))
+    output = torch.empty_like(hidden)
+    if rows:
+        _conv_residual_norm_kernel[(rows,)](
+            hidden,
+            coefficients,
+            base,
+            residual,
+            weight,
+            output,
+            hidden.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(1),
+            residual.stride(0),
+            width,
+            group_size,
+            base.shape[0],
+            query_len,
+            eps,
+            block,
+            num_warps=num_warps,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output, residual

+    """Parameters for normalization performed directly by the model kernels."""
+

+    X,

+    STRIDE_TOKEN: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_HEAD: tl.constexpr,

+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
